messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync — target cut for v0.15 is Thu 3pm PT. Need version tags on API, runtime, console, SDKs + changelogs by EOD Wed. Who's on queue?
Jorge: API: PR open https://git.internal/redwood/api/pull/482 awaiting review — two small docs changes. Should be green CI by tonight.
Priya: Runtime: still ironing a quantization tweak. I'll aim for PR by tomorrow morning. Need review from @Marta for perf numbers.
Marta: ack. I'll run the microbench this afternoon and post numbers. ETA ~4pm PT.
Sam: SDKs: already bumped package.json locally. PR coming in 30m. Tests flaky on node14, will fix.
Alyssa: @releasebot can you nudge console team? We need console changelog entry.
releasebot: Reminder queued -> #console: Please add changelog blurb for v0.15 by 18:00 PT tomorrow. :bell:
Marta: perf numbers look fine: median latency +2% but cost down 6% with quant changes. posting gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/perf-v0.15
Priya: thanks — will include in runtime changelog. @Jorge heads-up: runtime lowers token throughput in stress tests; need canary config update.
Jorge: noted. I'll add fallback to rtx-small in routing policy for canary window. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/89
Alyssa: Remember branch naming: use release/v0.15/<repo>. Tagging policy: do not force-push tags once created.
Sam: SDK PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/211 (3532-sdk-version-bump). CI green except for lint. Fix in flight.
Priya: pushing runtime PR now. Attaching command I used to bump: `./scripts/version-bump --repo runtime --ver 0.15.0`
Alyssa: If you can't make EOD Wed, call it out now — we may gate console until Friday but try not to.
Marta: small docs tweak to API required. pinging docs owner @Noah.
Noah: on it, will ship a one-line changelog entry in docs repo.
Jorge: One ask — can someone sanity-check integration tests for cross-repo compatibility (sdk <> api auth headers)? @Sam?
Sam: I can run a quick matrix today. Running: `python tests/integration/matrix.py --filter sdk,api` will post results.
devops-bot: Canary window scheduled Thu 18:00-20:00 PT. Auto-rollback enabled.
Alyssa: Perfect. Please drop PR links in the release checklist doc: https://docs.redwood/rel/v0.15/checklist
Priya: done.
Jorge: API PR merged. Changelog entry added by @Noah.
Sam: SDK PR merged after lint fix.
Marta: runtime PR merged, perf numbers in checklist.
Alyssa: Great work. Final reminder: cut = Thu 15:00 PT. After that only hotfixes via release/* branches. :tada:
releasebot: Release cutoff in 24h -> Thu 15:00 PT. Good luck!
